.tsx.description: React framework with routing, server rendering, and full-stack capabilities.
conversion_guidance: Use App Router conventions (app directory) for new projects.
Prefer Server Components by default; move to Client Components only when browser APIs are needed.
Use Route Handlers for API endpoints and server actions where appropriate.
Respect caching and revalidation controls for data fetching.
Keep server-only secrets out of client bundles.
project_structure: lib/ for utility and data access
middleware.ts for edge controls when needed
